feed.title: AI Wiki — Daily Signal
feed.subtitle: The day's most important AI model releases, lab announcements, and security news.

entry.title: LiteLLM PyPI package compromised to execute credential theft on startup
entry.summary: A supply chain attack against LiteLLM version 1.107.0 uses Python startup hooks to automatically steal credentials upon interpreter initialization.

entry.title: Moonshot launches Kimi K3.1 Pro with open weights scheduled for November
entry.summary: Moonshot introduced Kimi K3.1 Pro via API alongside a high-speed variant and committed to releasing open weights by November 4, 2026.

entry.title: OpenAI details offline environment isolation for frontier model training
entry.summary: OpenAI outlined updated security protocols for training frontier models, shifting to isolated offline environments and high-compute red-teaming.

entry.title: vLLM optimizes GLM-5.3 serving for 1M-token contexts on 16 H200s
entry.summary: Combining Context Parallelism techniques with Hybrid HiSparse enables efficient long-context prefill and decode for 1M-token serving.

entry.title: OpenAI details Habitat storage architecture supporting 1B ChatGPT users
entry.summary: Multi-tenancy, global caching, and Azure Cosmos DB integration delivered a 12x read speedup for ChatGPT online state storage.

entry.title: NVIDIA TensorRT 11.1 adds Global Performance Tuner across build routes
entry.summary: The tuner treats graph compilation as a global scheduling problem to automate multi-route performance tuning without sacrificing model accuracy.

entry.title: Naive RAG beats complex agentic memory in long-term conversation benchmarks
entry.summary: Direct dense retrieval and reranking over raw unmutated conversation histories outperforms complex agentic memory frameworks across long-term dialogue tasks.

entry.title: Reasoning models inherit pause markers from training data, not RL
entry.summary: Data provenance tracing reveals that reasoning models inherit pause tokens like wait from pretraining data rather than inventing them during reinforcement learning.

entry.title: Pairwise evaluation masks prompt-level scoring errors in LLM reward models
entry.summary: Standard pairwise evaluations hide major prompt-level reward model errors because models over-cluster scores by prompt compared to human raters.

entry.title: OpenAI Launches Decisions API for Fast, Low-Cost App Workflows
entry.summary: Provides a specialized API endpoint targeting low-latency, budget-conscious decision routing in agentic applications.

entry.title: Anthropic Donates Agent Skills Standard to Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation
entry.summary: Establishes an open, vendor-neutral governance framework for standardized agent tool definitions across the ecosystem.

entry.title: PyTorch NA 2026 Adds Native Support for Google TPUs and AWS Trainium
entry.summary: Expands multi-hardware portability by bringing first-class compiler and runtime backends for non-NVIDIA AI chips.

entry.title: IQuest-Q1 Releases Open 320B Sparse MoE Model for CLI Agents
entry.summary: Delivers an open 320B foundation model (15B activated) optimized specifically for command-line software engineering agents.

entry.title: Audit Shows Deleting Source Memories Fails to Erase Derived Agent Knowledge
entry.summary: Reveals that deleting root data in LLM agents leaves sensitive information intact within descendant downstream states.

entry.title: LLVMhammer Attack Uses Rowhammer Bit-Flips to Degrade GPU LLM Inference
entry.summary: Demonstrates physical DRAM attacks against Triton's compiler pipeline that permanently increase inference latency and cost.

entry.title: NVIDIA Announces Minerva Observability Platform to Maximize AI Factory GPU Uptime
entry.summary: Combines telemetry across compute, networking, and storage to diagnose yield losses and performance degradation in massive clusters.

entry.title: Deep Fusion Memory Injects Parametric Context Without Online Vector Retrieval
entry.summary: Predicts context memory chunks and fuses them directly into LLM intermediate states using gated cross-attention.

entry.title: Heartbeat Thinking Lets Voice Agents Speculatively Reason While User Speaks
entry.summary: Prevents tool cancellation during real-time speech by executing speculative reasoning continuously as transcripts update.

entry.title: Adaptive Sequence Models Found Leaking Future Tokens Despite Causal Masks
entry.summary: Reveals that full-sequence routing summaries can break causal invariance in autoregressive architectures even with strict causal attention masks.

entry.title: OpenAI Frontier Models Coming to Google Cloud Gemini Model Garden
entry.summary: Enables enterprise Google Cloud users to deploy OpenAI models directly alongside native Gemini workloads via Marketplace.

entry.title: Nation-State Threat Actor Uses ARTEX Agentic Framework in Supply Chain Attack
entry.summary: Marks a significant escalation in offensive AI operations, demonstrating real-world automated supply chain compromise driven by agentic frameworks.

entry.title: Cross-Session Memory Injections Demonstrated Across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini
entry.summary: Shows that long-term memory and Model Context Protocol features create persistent vulnerabilities allowing attackers to hijack future sessions.

entry.title: NVIDIA Kumo Relational Performs Zero-Shot Inference Across Complex Relational Databases
entry.summary: Eliminates custom ML pipeline training for enterprise relational database queries by executing zero-shot predictions directly on schemas.

entry.title: PyTorch Updates TorchTitan with Native TitanRL Support and 5D Parallelism
entry.summary: Unifies large-scale pre-training and agentic reinforcement learning pipelines into a single high-performance framework.

entry.title: Compaction Laundering Enables Persistent Instruction Forgery in Coding Agents
entry.summary: Flattening agent context history during compaction strips provenance metadata, leaving systems vulnerable to persistent post-compaction prompt injection.

entry.title: Meta Deploys Thin Orchestrator Pattern with Deterministic Routing for AI Agents
entry.summary: Demonstrates a scalable production architecture that reduces agent failures by using deterministic routing rather than LLM-driven orchestration.

entry.title: AKV Engine Enables Direct Proactive Agent KV Cache Control
entry.summary: Grants agents explicit drop and reposition primitives over KV caches to manage long-horizon trajectories without triggering context pre-fills.

entry.title: Autonomous AI Research Teams Discover Outperforming Linear Attention Architecture
entry.summary: Proves multi-agent systems with isolated histories can autonomously search architecture spaces and invent functional linear attention modules.

entry.title: LAW Replaces Autoregressive Token Generation with Pure Self-Conditioning
entry.summary: Shifts language generation to continuous space by propagating expected embeddings during sampling and decoding tokens only at the end.

entry.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Gov Models for Classified US National Security Use
entry.summary: Anthropic is deploying custom Claude variants directly into classified government environments for national security operations.

entry.title: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce GA of Vera Rubin NVL72 Infrastructure
entry.summary: Next-generation A5X cloud instances bring NVIDIA's Vera Rubin architecture to market for large-scale RL and agentic workloads.

entry.title: Google and Meta Release TorchTPU for Native PyTorch Execution on TPUs
entry.summary: TorchTPU enables standard PyTorch code and torch.compile to run natively on Google Cloud TPUs without custom XLA wrappers.

entry.title: Anthropic Expands Project Glasswing Vulnerability Scanning to 150 Organizations
entry.summary: Deploys Claude Mythos Preview across high-impact global software infrastructure to proactively identify zero-day vulnerabilities.

entry.title: Carryover Attacks Benchmark Reveals Long-Term Memory Vulnerability in LLM Agents
entry.summary: Demonstrates that indirect prompt injections stored in agent memory re-trigger across future sessions without signal decay.

entry.title: NVIDIA Introduces Sentry Framework for Runtime Security of AI Agents
entry.summary: Delivers out-of-reach runtime isolation and monitoring to prevent autonomous agents from altering security controls or escalating privileges.

entry.title: Anthropic Releases Compliance Framework for California SB 53 Legislation
entry.summary: Establishes an industry model for mandatory public disclosure and risk assessment ahead of California's frontier AI law.

entry.title: Study Shows Static Active Expert Reduction Outperforms Dynamic MoE Skipping
entry.summary: Demonstrates that complex dynamic expert skipping algorithms rarely beat simply lowering active experts statically when controlled for compute budget.

entry.title: Specter Accelerates Single-GPU MoE Inference via Multi-Step Speculative Offloading
entry.summary: Uses a quantized draft model to prefetch host-offloaded experts over PCIe before token verification, alleviating host memory bandwidth limits.

entry.title: RACE Prunes RoPE Rotary Pairs to Compress KV-Cache Without Retraining
entry.summary: Introduces a post-training compression method that prunes RoPE pairs by activation energy, natively reducing KV-cache memory and attention compute.

entry.title: Google Cloud Open-Sources TorchTPU for Native PyTorch Execution on TPUs
entry.summary: Engineers can now run native PyTorch workloads directly on Google Cloud TPUs without complex framework abstraction layers.

entry.title: Google Releases llm-d 1.0 for Distributed Agent Inference on TPUs and GPUs
entry.summary: Provides an open-source distributed serving runtime specifically designed for high-concurrency AI agent workloads across heterogeneous hardware.

entry.title: Kernel-Level Connection Escrow Holds AI Agent Egress Pending Isolated Verification
entry.summary: Uses a 98-instruction eBPF program to intercept agent socket creation in the Linux kernel, preventing compromised containers from exfiltrating data.

entry.title: LLM Financial Trading Agents Vulnerable to 100% ASR Data Injection Attacks
entry.summary: Demonstrates that fabricated news containing short template snippets can completely hijack autonomous market decisions by corrupting evidence context.

entry.title: vLLM Adds Bi-Directional KV Cache Transfer for Multi-Turn Agent Workloads
entry.summary: Significantly cuts time-to-first-token in agent interactions by allowing prefill nodes to fetch KV caches directly from decode nodes.

entry.title: OpenAI Focuses Evaluation Suite on Low-Resource Languages and COBOL Migration
entry.summary: New benchmarks directly target automated legacy enterprise code migration and performance in non-mainstream programming languages.

entry.title: Hybrid LLMs Suffer Competing Learning Between Recurrence and Attention Layers
entry.summary: Explains why hybrid SSM-attention architectures stall during training, showing that fast linear-time recurrence layers suppress attention gradients.

entry.title: Variational Decoding Enables Up to 5.7x Faster Parallel Token Generation
entry.summary: Bypasses standard autoregressive decoding by using latent auxiliary variables to generate multiple mutually consistent tokens in a single forward pass.

entry.title: Safety Mid-Training Internalizes Alignment Traces Before Post-Training Fine-Tuning
entry.summary: Inserting a dedicated safety phase between pre-training and post-training prevents safety degradation while enhancing core reasoning capabilities.

entry.title: Anthropic Commits 5% of Shares to New Public Benefit Fund
entry.summary: Anthropic is allocating 5% of its equity to fund public benefit initiatives as the lab scales.

entry.title: AWS and PyTorch Release TorchNeuron Native Backend for Trainium Chips
entry.summary: Engineers can now run, compile, and profile PyTorch code natively on AWS Trainium2 and Trainium3 hardware.

entry.title: Meta Details Prometheus Supercluster Scaling Toward One Million GPUs
entry.summary: Meta reveals architectural details of its gigawatt-scale New Albany supercluster used to train its Muse Wonder model.

entry.title: Microsoft Expands Project Perception to Governance of Agentic Insiders
entry.summary: Microsoft is building deterministic security controls to monitor and constrain non-deterministic autonomous AI agents in enterprise networks.

entry.title: Authorization-Grounded Attack Exploits Token Approvals to Bypass Document Access Controls
entry.summary: Demonstrates how tool-using agents can be tricked into abusing legitimate approval tokens without triggering explicit policy override detectors.

entry.title: Study Finds Low Prompt Injection Success in Small Agents Driven by Inattention
entry.summary: Auditing 33,000 trajectories reveals open-weight agents frequently ignore indirect injections rather than actively blocking or refusing them.

entry.title: Reasoning Models Obey Constraints Better When Placed in Internal Reasoning Channels
entry.summary: Self-instructions embedded directly within a model's chain-of-thought steer output far more reliably than system or user prompt constraints.

entry.title: Huginn Looped Transformer Architecture Reduces Resident Parameters by 75%
entry.summary: Demonstrates a recurrent dynamic architecture that matches feedforward MoE FLOP efficiency while drastically cutting memory overhead.

entry.title: Intra-Model Error Correlation Bottlenecks LLM Test-Time Compute Scaling
entry.summary: Identifies why adding test-time compute to a single model hits diminishing returns and shows heterogeneous model arbitration fixes it.

entry.title: Document Training Creates Transitive Behavioral Couplings in LLMs
entry.summary: Explains how fine-tuning an LLM for a specific task unexpectedly induces non-targeted, multi-step composed behaviors.

entry.title: AWS Automates Bedrock Private Pricing Offer Distribution Across Organizations
entry.summary: It allows enterprise platform teams to systematically deploy and govern negotiated Bedrock model pricing across multi-account AWS environments.

entry.title: Cold-Boot Physical Capture Bypasses Weight Rotation in Edge Image Classifiers
entry.summary: It proves that streaming multi-exit model weights into volatile edge memory fails to prevent physical model theft by sophisticated adversaries.

entry.title: LMCache Cuts Long-Context Remote KV Cache Prefill Latency to Sub-Second
entry.summary: It resolves critical remote KV cache bottlenecks in context-parallel prefill, dropping 16k-token p99 latency from 83s to 0.67s on FP8 GLM-5.3.

entry.title: Search-Augmented LLMs Systematically Ignore Retrieved Context for Parametric Memory
entry.summary: It exposes a critical failure mode in RAG systems where models fall back to outdated parametric knowledge despite relevant evidence in context.

entry.title: Sparse Autoencoders Require Vastly More Data for Feature Reproducibility Than Functionality
entry.summary: The authors show that functional performance metrics converge much faster than true feature stability, meaning standard SAE evaluations may mask poor interpretability.

entry.title: Open Midtraining Recipe Primes Base Models for Agentic Post-Training
entry.summary: It provides a reproducible recipe for 256K context midtraining on software data and execution traces to improve downstream agentic performance.

entry.title: Unembedding Dynamics Reveal Output Layer Lags Hidden States in LLM Pretraining
entry.summary: It introduces a framework to track how unembedding layers evolve relative to internal representations during language model pretraining.

entry.title: Reflection AI releases Reflection Beam, a 501B open-weight sparse MoE
entry.summary: It introduces a 501B parameter open-weight agentic coding model with 23B active parameters deployed directly on AWS and vLLM.

entry.title: Microsoft and NVIDIA publish enterprise risk framework for open-weight models
entry.summary: Provides a standardized enterprise taxonomy and mitigation framework for operationalizing open-weight LLMs safely.

entry.title: TorchTitan adds Zephon for elastic deterministic data loading across GPU resizes
entry.summary: Ensures strict, reproducible global batch ordering during distributed LLM training even when cluster allocations scale dynamically.

entry.title: INFUSE benchmark evaluates indirect prompt injection in long-horizon agents
entry.summary: Fills a critical gap in security testing by evaluating indirect injection attacks across realistic multi-step agent workflows.

entry.title: vLLM achieves 840 tokens per second for Kimi K3 on GB300
entry.summary: Demonstrates extreme single-batch decode throughput for large models using specialized CuTe DSL kernels on NVIDIA Blackwell architecture.

entry.title: Virtual Head Attention cuts KV cache footprint beyond GQA and MLA
entry.summary: Introduces linear pre/post-mixing operations to halve physical query heads and lower KV memory overhead while outperforming existing GQA and MLA architectures.

entry.title: Machine unlearning fails to prevent cross-lingual information retrieval
entry.summary: Demonstrates that behavioral unlearning in one language leaves underlying knowledge accessible via semantically equivalent queries in alternative languages or scripts.

entry.title: RoleQ enables post-training 1.58-bit ternary LLM quantization
entry.summary: Converts pre-trained LLMs to 1.59 bits per weight post-training by scaling parameters according to Transformer unit roles rather than uniform matrix layouts.

entry.title: Meta Releases Muse Spark Open 816B Multimodal Model
entry.summary: Meta's new flagship open-weights model brings an 816B parameter MoE architecture and 1M context window to agentic developer workflows.

entry.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt Edge Models
entry.summary: NVIDIA expands its model stack with a 120B vision-language MoE for continuous agent workflows alongside lightweight edge variants.

entry.title: MCP Server Security Flaws Expose Filesystem Credentials and Prompt CVEs
entry.summary: Audits of Model Context Protocol implementations revealed capability laundering vulnerabilities across 787 servers, including two CVEs in Anthropic's Git MCP server.

entry.title: Anthropic Q3 Revenue Hits $16.8 Billion Amid Model Distillation Crackdown
entry.summary: Anthropic's massive quarter-over-quarter revenue growth comes alongside aggressive technical and legal actions against unauthorized third-party distillation.

entry.title: AMD MI355X Outperforms NVIDIA B300 in Agent Interactivity Benchmark
entry.summary: vLLM optimizations allow AMD's flagship GPU to deliver 87% higher TCO throughput per dollar when serving Kimi K3 under strict interactivity SLAs.

entry.title: Open-Weight AI Models Found Vulnerable to Persistent Trigger-Based Backdoors
entry.summary: Researchers demonstrate that modified open-weights, including community abliterated builds, can contain hidden backdoors that silently exfiltrate user data.

entry.title: Training-Free On-Policy Distillation Merges Models Without Gradients
entry.summary: This technique aggregates fine-tuned specialist models into a single base model using layer-wise least-squares regression over activation statistics, eliminating backpropagation entirely.

entry.title: Pretrained Representation Linearity Predicts Post-Fine-Tuning Generalization
entry.summary: A study across 11 language models proves that how linearly readable a relation's facts are in pretrained weights directly dictates post-fine-tuning generalization.

entry.title: Data World Enables Automated RL-Zero Environment and Agent Synthesis
entry.summary: Synthesizing environments directly from underlying mechanism specifications allows complex agent models to be trained via RL from scratch without trajectory distillation.

entry.title: llm-gemini 0.35 Adds Support for Gemini 4 Argon
entry.summary: Google's new Gemini 4 Argon model is now accessible via the llm CLI tool and API.

entry.title: Cloudflare Acquires Deno to Advance Self-Hostable Workers
entry.summary: Cloudflare is acquiring Deno to advance self-hostable Workers while sunsetting official Deno runtime development after one year.

entry.title: Quantized LLM Supply Chain Risk: GGUF Models Lack Build Verifiability
entry.summary: Audit reveals zero out of 198 top Hugging Face GGUF models can be independently re-derived bit-for-bit due to missing build environment coordinates.

entry.title: CVE-2026-65616 Details Privilege Escalation Vulnerabilities From RL Training
entry.summary: Forensic analysis shows how RL/RLHF training configurations create exploitable privilege escalation vulnerabilities in deployed AI agents.

entry.title: vLLM Adds Push-Based RDMA KV Transfer for Disaggregated Inference
entry.summary: Pushing KV cache directly to decode memory over RDMA improves prefill-decode disaggregation performance across accelerator clusters.

entry.title: Google DeepMind Releases AI Control Roadmap for Agent Threats
entry.summary: DeepMind introduces the TRAIT&R taxonomy to treat advanced internal AI agents as potential insider threats.

entry.title: Continuum Attention Replaces Discrete KV Lookups With Memory Curves
entry.summary: Replaces discrete key-value lookups in Transformer decoders with continuous piecewise linear memory curve integration.

entry.title: Latent Compaction Uses Test-Time Training for 32x KV Compression
entry.summary: Uses test-time training to compress document KV caches up to 32x without updating model weights.

entry.title: Study Shows NO-THINK RL Reasoning Gains Stem From Thinking Leakage
entry.summary: Demonstrates that reasoning gains in non-thinking modes reactivate existing thinking abilities rather than learning novel behaviors.

entry.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Argon Frontier Model
entry.summary: Google released its next-generation frontier model to tackle complex reasoning and enterprise workloads.

entry.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B Open MoE Model for On-Device Agents
entry.summary: Offers a high-performance open-weights architecture tuned for private, low-latency local agent execution.

entry.title: SpaceXAI Grok 4.7 Available on Amazon Bedrock with 500K Context
entry.summary: Brings Grok 4.7's long-context and variable-reasoning capabilities directly to Bedrock enterprise pipelines.

entry.title: Microsoft Patches Remote Code Execution Vulnerability in Visual Studio Copilot
entry.summary: Fixes a critical path validation bypass (CVE-2026-103572) that allowed arbitrary code execution in developer environments.

entry.title: NVIDIA Open-Sources Run:ai Workload and GPU Orchestration Platform
entry.summary: Gives enterprise infrastructure teams free access to production-grade GPU cluster management within the DSX AI Factory platform.

entry.title: Anthropic Replaces Git with Custom Source Control to Handle AI Code Generation
entry.summary: Highlights how high-volume AI code synthesis is forcing foundational shifts away from legacy software development tooling.

entry.title: SA-CUA Prevents Indirect Prompt Injections in Computer Use Agents
entry.summary: Uses accessibility trees to dynamically mask untrusted visual elements, securing GUI agents without requiring manual approval.

entry.title: Jeva Architectures Replace Autoregressive Decoding for Rapid System-1 Decisions
entry.summary: Introduces a non-autoregressive decision stack that processes candidates independently for fast, cached decision-making.

entry.title: DPOison-VL Demonstrates Clean-Image Preference Poisoning Against Vision-Language DPO
entry.summary: Shows that imperceptible perturbations on just 2% of visual alignment data can achieve up to a 98% attack success rate.
